message: Comparator and treatment are symmetric and fully specified (same lags [1-4], same 4/13-week rolling means, same absence of yoy/promo/trend/category/clip/window/series_mean, same alpha=1.0), differing only in the log(1+demand)+naive-expm1 transform — this matches the estimand in kills_if exactly ((WAPE_comparator-WAPE_treatment)/WAPE_comparator). Features (lags, trailing rolling means) are computed from past data only, so no forward-leakage risk given the exclusions stated. kills_if is concrete and correctly operationalizes the fixed SESOI/alpha as a one-sided 97.5% bound. The yoy resolution in the rationale is internally consistent: this hid's statement explicitly excludes yoy from both arms, which is a legitimate narrower ceteris-paribus test of the log transform alone; the yoy/last-year-demand feature is correctly deferred as a separate hypothesis rather than folded into this treatment. No blocking issues. Approved.
new_hypothesis_for_pi: Separate preregistration: pooled ridge with demand lags 1-4, 4/13-week rolling means, plus last year's demand over the same 4-week window (yoy feature) as comparator vs. the same feature set with log(1+demand) target and naive inverse transform as treatment — to test whether the log-transform effect holds once yoy is included, and optionally whether a bias-corrected (e.g., variance-adjusted) inverse transform changes the effect size relative to the naive expm1 used here.
